title: Hiring Landscape Architect for a company at Kirti Nagar, Delhi
description:

* Conduct site assessments and analysis to determine project feasibility and potential environmental impact
* Develop landscape plans, including grading and drainage plans, planting plans, and hardscape design

* Professional license as a Landscape Architect.

* Membership in professional organizations such as the American Society of Landscape Architects (ASLA).

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Landscape Architecture or a related field

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines
* Passion for sustainability and environmentally conscious design practice

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Talent Acquisition Specialist**

**Company: PERCH Brands Pvt. Ltd.**

**Experience: 4–5 Years**

**Location: West Delhi**

**Work Mode: Full-Time, On-site**

**Working Days: 6 Days a Week**

**About PERCH Brands**

**PERCH Brands is a rapidly growing homegrown D2C menswear brand, established in 2023. We focus on premium-quality menswear, in-house manufacturing, craftsmanship and design innovation, creating contemporary styles tailored to the modern Indian man.**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for an experienced and proactive Talent Acquisition Specialist with 4–5 years of experience, preferably from a recruitment consultancy or staffing agency background. The candidate should have strong expertise in end-to-end recruitment, along with the ability to lead and manage the HR team.**

**The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing recruitment requirements, building effective HR processes and driving overall people operations.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment**

* **Lead end-to-end recruitment across all departments, including but not limited to e-commerce, marketing, sales, operations and corporate functions.**
* **Manage high-volume and niche hiring requirements through multiple sourcing channels.**
* **Experience in recruitment agency operations, client coordination and candidate management.**
* **Develop effective sourcing strategies using Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, referrals and other recruitment platforms.**
* **Conduct screening, HR interviews, salary negotiations and offer management.**
* **Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring requirements.**
* **Monitor recruitment metrics, hiring TAT and closure ratios.**

**2. HR Operations & Policies**

* **Develop, implement and maintain HR policies, SOPs and internal processes.**
* **Manage employee onboarding, documentation, attendance, leave management and employee records.**
* **Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters and performance-related issues.**
* **Ensure proper implementation of company policies and HR procedures.**
* **Manage employee exits, full and final settlement coordination and exit formalities.**
* **Maintain HR documentation and ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.**

**3. HR Team Leadership**

* **Lead, supervise and manage the HR team and delegate responsibilities effectively.**
* **Set recruitment and HR operational targets and monitor team performance.**
* **Guide team members on recruitment strategies, candidate evaluation and HR processes.**
* **Establish structured reporting systems and improve overall team productivity.**
* **Coordinate with department heads and management for workforce planning and manpower requirements.**

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **4–5 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition and HR Operations.**
* **Prior experience working with a recruitment consultancy or staffing agency is strongly preferred.**
* **Strong understanding of HR policies, recruitment processes and employee lifecycle management.**
* **Prior experience managing or leading an HR team.**
* **Good communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.**
* **Strong decision-making, problem-solving and coordination abilities.**
* **Proficiency in recruitment portals, HRMS and MS Excel.**

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Energeia is an Industrial Energy Savings Company. We find energy waste in factories and commercial buildings, fix it, and get paid from the savings we verify. Since 2018 we have completed 1,200+ site appraisals and 250+ energy audits, and saved customers ₹256 Crore in energy costs. We are a BEE-accredited ESCO with offices in 5 cities and technology partnerships with ABB, L&T and GFS Corp (USA).

In August 2026 we launched August Energeia with Singapore-based August Energy: a $100M platform that finances, installs and operates energy infrastructure for Indian industry, so customers pay from savings instead of upfront capex. Energeia brings the audits, engineering, sales and the IoT and AI platform behind every project.

**WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW**

We are scaling from 54 people toward 75 over the next 12 months without losing the culture that got us here. You will design how.

Payroll and compliance have to stay flawless. The next phase also needs auditors and engineers hired faster than the market, a performance system people trust, and retention we measure instead of guess. This role reports to the CEO, with a clear path to Head of People.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

• Hiring: end-to-end recruitment across 5 cities, from trainees to senior leaders, through Naukri, LinkedIn, agencies and referrals

• Structured hiring: scorecards for every role, and coaching hiring managers to use them

• Onboarding: joining, induction and 30/60/90 plans for every new hire

• Payroll and HR operations: monthly payroll, attendance and leave reconciliation in Zoho People, and every employee letter from offer to relieving

• Statutory compliance: PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, Shops and Establishments and annual labour-law returns in every state we operate in

• Performance: goal setting, probation reviews and the annual review cycle with calibration

• Employee relations: a logged grievance mechanism, fair and confidential investigations, and exits through full-and-final

• Engagement and retention: eNPS, surveys, town halls and recognition; analyse attrition and act on it

• Company offsites: plan and run offsites end to end, from agenda and venue to logistics and budget

• HR systems and MIS: monthly headcount, attrition and hiring dashboards; handbook, policies and SOPs; AI tools to automate the routine

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

• 30 days: fully onboarded on our systems: Zoho People, payroll, statutory filings and POSH

• 90 days: hiring and recruitment plan aligned with the CEO and function heads

• 6 months: 10 roles hired, written goals for every employee, zero payroll errors

• 12 months: ~20 roles closed with median time-to-hire under 45 days and 90-day retention of 85%+; review cycle completed with calibrated ratings; 100% statutory compliance; eNPS baseline set and improving

**WHAT YOU BRING**

• 6 to 10 years in HR, including 3+ as the senior HR person in a growing company of roughly 50 to 500 people

• End-to-end recruitment at volume, including technical or field roles, with time-to-hire and quality numbers you can quote

• Hands-on payroll ownership on an HRMS, ideally Zoho People

• Working knowledge of Indian labour law and multi-state statutory compliance, including POSH

• Has designed or run a performance review cycle end to end

• Can build a headcount and attrition report from raw data in Excel or Google Sheets

• Sound judgement and discretion on grievances, exits and pay

**STRONG PLUS**

• MBA or PGDM in HR, or a master's in HR or Industrial Relations

• Hiring engineers, auditors or site teams in manufacturing, EPC, energy or industrial services

• Startup or scale-up experience

• POSH Internal Committee experience

• Zoho One, and daily use of AI tools (Claude or similar)

**HOW WE WORK**

• Trust: radical openness and transparency in everything we do

• Growth mindset: experiment, fail forward, invest in your own learning

• Ownership: results-driven people who solve more than their own problems

• Community: collaborative, inclusive teams that enjoy working together

• Fairness and decency: do what is right, not what is easier

• Resilience: welcome the challenges that push us, and come back stronger

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• Competitive compensation based on experience

• A direct line to the CEO and a defined path to Head of People

• A people function in its biggest growth phase, yours to build

• Exposure to global partners: ABB, GFS Corp and August Energy

**THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**

• You want to set strategy and hand payroll to a team. For the first year, you are the team.

• You need a finished HR playbook. Much of ours is still being written, and you will write it.

• You wait for problems to reach you. Grievances, attrition and compliance deadlines need someone who goes looking.

Energeia is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skill and ownership, and welcome applicants of every background.

Hiring Procedure for GSL Recruitment 2026
  
  

* Eligibility of the applicants is initially checked on the basis of the notified qualification, experience and age requirements.

* Travel Allowance: Economy Airfare to outstation and AC II Tier Rail fare (ECS) to lower posts is admissible for interview candidates for CGM and GM posts. Tickets that are waitlisted are not refunded to GSL.
* NOC Rule: All government and PSU staff must be vetted via the appropriate channel with a No Objection Certificate required (except in the case of fixed term contracts).
* Call Letters: Only GSL sends call letters via email, so be sure to have an email account and check it on a daily basis.
* Canvassing: If there is an effort to gain influence, disqualification.
* Fixed-Term Posts: can be three years plus two, does not continue in perpetuity and provides no guarantee of regular employment.

* Click on the “Careers” link and then click on the “Advertisement” page.
* Click on Direct Recruitment “Advertisement No. 06/2026 (FOR EXECUTIVE)“.

* Click the Apply Online button, and select the position to apply to.
* Sign up for your name, contact information and email address and remember and store the credentials securely.
* Complete the qualification, experience and category information and upload the photograph, signature and supporting documentation within the stipulations.
* Check the finished form and then submit it – changes cannot be made after the form is submitted.
* You have to pay the fee via SBI e-pay and download the fee receipt after the successful payment.
* Take two printouts of the submitted form and post one copy with self attested documents to the General Manager (HR&A), HR&A Department, Goa Shipyard Limited, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa 403802 so that it reaches by December 2, 2026.
* Candidates who check the GSL Chief General Manager Recruitment 2026 must keep the registration number until the process is complete along with the password and fee receipt.

FAQs
  
  
The advertisement offers 41 posts in total, 31 regular + 10 fixed term. There are Chief General Manager and Additional General Manager, Manager, Deputy Manager, to Junior Manager positions in finance, technical, safety, legal and information technology, ship repair sectors.

title: Team Leader-Human Resources
description:
**Organization- Andaz Delhi**
**Summary**
****Operational****

* Assists in making sure that Employee Facilities are maintained to Hyatt International's high standards of operation.
* Assists with the development, implementation and administration of employee relations, benefit and compensation, and recruitment programs.
* Maintains all applications, screen and interview applicants suitable for positions.
* Maintains an updated list of applicants and applicant files.
* Carries out recruitment activities, prepares and posts vacancy announcements.
* Prepares and places newspaper and internet advertisements for open positions.
* Contacts applicants for screening interviews.
* Coordinates and attends job fairs.
* Screens applications and resumes.
* Interviews candidates when necessary and refers suitable candidates to Department Heads.
* Ensures that all applications are reviewed and that acknowledgment/reject letters are sent out 2 weeks from date of receipt.
* Co-ordinates all visas and immigration activities when necessary and monitor the passports and immigration papers of foreign national employees.
* Prepares letters of offer to new hires.
* Checks and documents applicant references.
* Assists with the coordination of the employee recognition programmes.

****People****

* Assists to ensure that all employees are treated fairly and consistently as outlined in their terms and conditions of employment, local legislation, and company/hotel policies and procedures.
* Ensures a strong professional relationship with all levels of employees within the hotel.
* Ensures that all employees have a complete understanding of and adhere to employee rules and regulations.
* Conducts new employee orientation when necessary.
* Supports the implementation of The People Philosophy in every department in the hotel.
* Conducts Exit Interviews for all resigned employees if necessary and provide feedback to the Personnel Manager.

****Administration****

* Provides smooth and efficient administrative support in the Human Resources Department by assisting the Personnel Manager/Director of Human Resources in the planning, coordination and implementation of all office administration of the Human Resources Office.
* Responsible for the security and upkeep of personnel files
* Coordinates and administers all paper flow within the Department.
* Ensures that personnel records are maintained accurately and efficiently.
* Prepares a monthly vacancy report.

****Customer Service****

* Handles all guest and internal customer complaints and inquiries in a courteous and efficient manner, following through to ensure problems are resolved satisfactorily
* Maintains positive guest and colleague interactions with good working relationships.
* Provides the appropriate level of professional, courteous and caring service to other employees (internal customers) and other visitors to the division.

****Financial****

* Be conversant with productivity ratios (and other key performance indicators) and to produce the monthly turnover report, employee sick leave report, vacation reports.
* Ensures that all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to financial record keeping, money handling and licensing are adhered to, including the timely and accurate reporting of financial information.

****Marketing****

* Assists the Personnel Manager with the compilation and implementation of all employee communications.
* Ensures that all in-house rules, regulations and personnel announcements are communicated to employees via notice board and/or e-mail channels.
* Assists to prepare and monitor the Human Resources Calendar.

****Other duties****

* Attends and contributes to all Learning sessions and meetings as required.
* Is knowledgeable in statutory legislation in Associate and industrial relations.
* Exercises responsible management and behaviour at all times and positively representing the hotel management team and Hyatt International.
* Maintains strong, professional relationship with the relevant representatives from competitor hotels, business partners and other organisations.
* Reads the hotel's Associate Handbook and have an understanding of and adhere to the hotel's rules and regulations and in particular, the policies and procedures relating to fire, hygiene, health and safety.
* Ensures high standards of personal presentation and grooming.
* Responds to changes in the Human Resources function as dictated by the industry, company and hotel.

title: Operations & Talent Generalist
description:
**Operations & Talent Generalist
﻿**

**Location:**
Ghaziabad / NCR

**Company:**
MedsBee

**Experience:**
0–3 years

**Type:**
Full-time

About MedsBee

MedsBee is a healthcare talent platform focused on helping hospitals, diagnostic centres and healthcare companies hire doctors across India.

We work across specialist hiring including Radiology, Critical Care, Internal Medicine and other clinical roles.

We're building MedsBee differently from a traditional recruitment agency — with a small, high-ownership team using technology, data, AI and strong execution to solve difficult healthcare hiring problems.

We're now looking for an
**Operations & Talent Generalist**
to work closely with the founder.

What will you actually do?

You will own healthcare hiring mandates from problem to outcome.

That means you may:

* Identify and reach out to doctors across India
* Speak with candidates and understand their requirements
* Find creative ways of sourcing candidates when traditional channels aren't working
* Screen and shortlist candidates
* Coordinate interviews and follow-ups
* Manage candidate pipelines and trackers
* Analyse why particular roles are difficult to close
* Research salaries, locations and talent markets
* Communicate with clients when required
* Experiment with new sourcing channels and tools
* Use AI, automation and data to make our recruitment process faster
* Help improve MedsBee's internal systems and processes

This is
**not a role where you will receive an SOP for every task**
.

Who are we looking for?

We're less concerned about your exact degree or previous job title and more interested in how you think and work.

You may be a good fit if you:

* Take ownership without needing constant follow-ups
* Are comfortable making calls and speaking with new people
* Are persistent without being pushy
* Can figure things out when instructions aren't clear
* Enjoy solving difficult problems
* Work quickly and stay organised
* Communicate clearly in English and Hindi
* Are comfortable with spreadsheets and technology
* Use or are interested in using AI tools
* Can handle rejection without losing momentum
* Don't consider any reasonable task "beneath your role"
* Prefer responsibility over rigid job descriptions

Recruitment experience is useful but
**not mandatory**
.

We are open to candidates from recruitment, sales, operations, healthcare, startups or other backgrounds if they demonstrate strong ownership and learning ability.

What this role is NOT

This may not be the right role if you:

* Prefer highly structured jobs with fixed responsibilities
* Need detailed instructions before starting every task
* Are uncomfortable making calls
* Measure success primarily by completing assigned activities
* Want a role limited strictly to recruitment or operations

What you'll get

* Direct exposure to the founder
* Responsibility from the beginning
* Opportunity to build systems rather than simply follow them
* Exposure to healthcare recruitment, operations, sales and technology
* Performance-linked incentives
* Opportunity to take significantly larger ownership as MedsBee grows

Compensation

₹25,000–₹35,000 per month depending on experience and capability + performance-linked incentives.

Exceptional candidates outside this range may also be considered.

In EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
  
  
**The opportunity**
You will act as a Recruitment Partner for Business Leaders and have opportunity to derive insights from data and turn ideas into action. You will propose and execute programs(s) in the areas of Employer Branding, Diversity & Inclusion, Tools and Automation to ensure we achieve impactful results. We are committed to drive improvements for our business and our people, supportive of EY culture and as a result enhance customer experience.
  
  
Being a Partner in an Individual Contributor role, need to engage closely with Business Operations’ Managers and Hiring Managers to help hiring as per pre-defined hiring turnaround timelines of quality resources with effective stake-holder management skills by meeting standard compliance and risk guidelines.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Forecasting business requirement, planning for sourcing strategies to enable just-in-time and pro-active hiring.
* Drive informed, data driven decisions.
* Cultivating strong business relationships with frequent connects with stakeholders and potential candidates.
* Drive organisational best practices.
* Deliver projects for large scale hiring for cross-functional audiences.
* Responsible for operational speed to procure offers selection, conduct best in class offer negotiation, offer roll-out and effective post-offer acceptance management.
* Ensure all positions are closed on time and within the budgeted cost.
* Responsible for tracking and measuring hiring metrics.

* Manage stakeholders including senior leaders and build strong relationships.
* Strong verbal and written business communication, active listening and interpretation skills
* Strong influencing abilities
* Ability to communicate complex information in an approachable manner.
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy.
* Strong client focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Exposure to professional services hiring and proven skill of large volume hiring.
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent teams.
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups.

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
* 4 - 6 years of proven recruitment experience, managing large scale and complex hiring
* Should have experience working on various HR applications including Applicant Tracking System
* Experience in developing hiring strategy for competencies based on the forecast and propose achievable plan

title: Human Resources Lead
description:
Are you an HR professional who wants to do more than paperwork? Ready to build a culture, not just manage one?

At Sheows, we believe a company is only as strong as its people. We are looking for a sharp, driven and people-first HR Lead to own our HR function and play a key role in our next phase of growth.

Job Snapshot

Location: Gurgaon

Experience: 4 to 7 years in HR

Salary: ₹60,000 – ₹70,000 per month

Job Type: Full-time, Work from Office

Reports To: CEO

Joining: Immediate

About the Role

This is a leadership position, not a support role. As HR Lead, you will be the face of HR at Sheows, working directly with the leadership team to attract the right talent, keep them engaged and build systems that scale with the business.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition

* Own the complete hiring cycle: manpower planning, JD creation, sourcing, screening, interviews, offer negotiation and closure
* Build a strong talent pipeline through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and campus channels
* Reduce time-to-hire while maintaining quality of hire

Onboarding & Induction

* Run a smooth onboarding process, from documentation to day-one experience
* Conduct induction programs so new joiners settle in faster

Employee Engagement & Culture

* Plan engagement activities, recognition programs and team-building initiatives
* Collect regular feedback and act on it to improve retention

Performance Management

* Design and run KRA/KPI-based performance review cycles
* Support managers with appraisals, feedback and development plans

HR Operations

* Manage attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee records
* Maintain HR MIS, dashboards and monthly reports

Statutory Compliance & Legal

* Ensure timely registration, filing and compliance under:
* EPF (Employees’ Provident Fund): monthly ECR filing and contributions
* ESIC (Employees’ State Insurance): registration, contributions and returns
* Payment of Gratuity Act
* Minimum Wages Act and applicable state wage regulations
* Shops & Establishment Act (registration, renewals, leave and working-hours norms)
* Professional Tax and TDS on salary (coordinating with the finance/accounts team)
* Maternity Benefit Act and other applicable labour laws
* POSH Act: constitution and functioning of the Internal Committee (IC), annual reports and awareness sessions
* Maintain statutory registers, records and documentation, and stay audit-ready at all times
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors and government authorities during inspections and audits
* Keep track of changes in labour codes and update company policies accordingly

Policy & Employee Relations

* Create, update and implement HR policies, SOPs, appointment letters and employee handbook
* Handle grievances and disciplinary matters fairly and confidentially
* Manage exit formalities, including exit interviews, notice period, and full & final settlement

Strategic Partnership

* Advise leadership on organization structure, compensation and workforce planning
* Strengthen Sheows’ employer brand on LinkedIn and other platforms

What We’re Looking For

Must have

* Bachelor’s degree in any stream; MBA / PGDM in HR preferred
* 4 to 7 years of hands-on HR experience, with at least 1 to 2 years in a lead role
* Strong command over end-to-end recruitment and HR operations
* Solid working knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance (EPF, ESIC, Gratuity, Bonus, PT, POSH, Shops & Establishment Act)
* Hands-on experience in compliance filings, audits and handling inspections
* Excellent communication, negotiation and people-management skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS tools and LinkedIn Recruiter
* Comfortable working from the office on a full-time basis

Good to have

* Experience in a startup or fast-growing company
* Exposure to payroll processing and HR analytics
* Knowledge of the new Labour Codes
* Experience in employer branding initiatives

You’ll Thrive Here If You

* Take ownership and don’t wait to be told what to do
* Are equally comfortable with people and data
* Are detail-oriented and never miss a compliance deadline
* Stay calm under pressure and handle sensitive situations with maturity
* Think like a business partner, not just an HR executive

Why Join Sheows?

Leadership role with real ownership and direct access to decision-makers

Growth-oriented environment where you shape the HR function

Competitive salary of ₹60,000 – ₹70,000 per month

People-first culture that values respect, learning and accountability

Collaborative office environment where you work closely with the team and leadership

Exposure to every part of the business

How to Apply

Apply directly through this post or send your updated CV to hrgurgaon@sheows.org with the subject line “HR Lead ”.

title: Senior Associate - Talent Acquisition Researcher
description:
**Senior Associate, Talent Acquisition Researcher**

**Location:**
Gurgaon, Haryana, India

**Experience:**
5–8 years of relevant talent research experience

***Thehirehub.AI is helping Alvarez and Marsal for this particular mandate.***

**About the Company**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global professional services firm providing advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services to companies, investors and government entities. Founded in 1983 as a restructuring boutique, A&M is known for practical, action-oriented solutions that improve performance, create value and accelerate results across six continents. Its mission is to help organizations tackle complex business issues, boost operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. In 2023, A&M established a Global Capability Center in India to support global business units, case delivery and thought leadership across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. The Gurgaon center partners with teams across Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. A&M values integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, guided by leadership, action and results.

**About the Role**

As Senior Associate, Talent Acquisition Researcher, you will own high-quality talent research and intelligence for priority hiring across Alvarez & Marsal globally. You will partner with recruiters, hiring managers, senior stakeholders and fellow Researchers to translate search objectives into focused market maps, target company lists, executive pipelines and actionable sourcing insights. The role is centered on the core talent research process, with particular emphasis on talent intelligence and mapping professionals from SHREK organisations, including recruitment firms and executive search firms. You will use LinkedIn Recruiter, X-Ray search, Lusha, ContactOut, company websites, industry sources, conference materials, executive biographies, web research and AI tools such as Claude and Copilot. Your work will improve search precision, shorten research cycles and strengthen delivery for business-critical roles across functions and geographies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own target company lists, talent maps and executive pipelines for priority searches, focusing on SHREK organisations and converting fragmented market information into qualified, actionable talent pools.
* Participate in search kick-offs with recruiters and hiring managers, clarifying target profiles, relevant organisations, sourcing channels and research plans that improve search focus from the outset.
* Conduct structured executive research across social networks, search engines, company websites, conferences, publications, referrals and biographies to identify niche and hard-to-find professionals.
* Apply Claude, Copilot and other AI tools to accelerate candidate research, market mapping and sourcing insight while preserving accuracy, discretion and sound judgement.
* Build dashboards and reports covering talent availability, candidate movement, company activity and market trends so stakeholders can make better-informed search decisions.
* Maintain intelligence on mergers and acquisitions, private equity transactions, competitor activity and wider talent trends, translating developments into relevant implications for active searches.
* Partner with recruiters and Researchers to maintain accurate, consistent candidate information across recruiting systems and research tools, protecting data quality throughout delivery.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Demonstrated expertise in core talent research, talent intelligence, executive search research and end-to-end market mapping, particularly across recruitment firms and executive search firms.
* Strong research, information synthesis and data organisation skills, with the ability to turn competitive landscape and candidate intelligence into concise sourcing recommendations.
* Hands-on proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, X-Ray search, Lusha, ContactOut, company websites, industry publications, conference research and broader web searches.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve research targeting, repeatability and cycle time without compromising judgement or confidentiality.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, enabling effective partnership with recruiters, hiring managers, Researchers and senior stakeholders across geographies.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint for analysis, reporting and presentation; Power BI or comparable visualisation experience is advantageous.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience supporting executive searches in professional services, consulting, finance, tax or private equity environments, with awareness of relevant talent pools and market dynamics.
* Experience tracking mergers and acquisitions, private equity transactions, competitor activity or other market signals that influence executive talent availability.
* Exposure to Power BI or other data visualisation tools for presenting talent market trends, company intelligence and candidate movement clearly.

**What You'll Bring**

* A Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Human Resources, or a related discipline, combined with 5–8 years of relevant talent research experience; total experience may range from 6–10 years.
* Deep ownership of the core talent research process, including talent intelligence, target organisation mapping, executive pipeline development and research-led sourcing strategy.
* Proven ability to find niche profiles through disciplined investigation, connect disparate information sources and deliver reliable insights under demanding timelines.
* High attention to detail, discretion and sound judgement when handling confidential searches and candidate information, supported by strong prioritisation and deadline management.
* A collaborative, proactive working style that builds trust with recruiters, hiring managers, senior stakeholders and research colleagues across international teams.
* Curiosity about organisations, industries and professional networks, with the resilience to pursue difficult searches until the market picture is sufficiently complete.
* Commitment to accurate recruiting data, consistent documentation and candidate experience throughout each search, ensuring research quality directly strengthens hiring outcomes.

**Why Join Us**

At Alvarez & Marsal, your research will directly influence how a global professional services firm builds teams for complex, high-impact work. The Talent Acquisition Research team is central to priority hiring, giving you ownership of market intelligence, executive pipelines and search strategy rather than limiting the role to transactional sourcing. You will work with recruiters, hiring managers and senior stakeholders across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, gaining exposure to varied functions, industries and geographies. A&M’s entrepreneurial culture values independent thinkers who take action and deliver results, while its inclusive environment respects different perspectives and encourages strong collaboration. The India Global Capability Center offers the scale of an international platform with meaningful proximity to case teams and business leaders. Through mentorship, A&M University, formal training, on-the-job learning, internal mobility and performance development, you can deepen your research craft and broaden your career. The firm also invests in wellbeing, employee resource groups, community contribution and flexible support practices. You will join a growing organization where practical insight, professional judgement and high-quality delivery are visible and valued.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to support global, business-critical hiring across multiple functions, industries and geographies while working alongside experienced recruiters, Researchers and senior stakeholders.
* Structured development through A&M University, formal training, on-the-job learning, mentorship, internal mobility and a performance process that recognizes meaningful contributions.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment with wellbeing resources, employee resource groups, comprehensive benefits and opportunities to contribute through community programs.
* Competitive compensation within a culture that combines early responsibility, entrepreneurial ownership, professional growth and practical impact.

title: Greenhouse ATS Systems Support Analyst
description:
**About Inizio**

Inizio is a global partner with over 10,500 experts operating in more than 50 countries. We support health and life science companies by turning science into strategy and executing across the product and patient journey. Our services include market research, strategy consulting, transformation consulting, and commercial benchmarking, all designed to be data-backed and patient-inspired.

**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and systems-focused Greenhouse ATS/ Talent Acquisition Systems Support Analyst to support the administration, maintenance, optimization, and reporting of our recruitment technology ecosystem, with a primary focus on Greenhouse ATS.
  
  
This role will serve as the first point of contact for recruitment system support, ensuring recruiters, hiring managers, and HR stakeholders have a seamless experience using our recruiting technologies. The successful candidate will be responsible for system configuration, user support, data integrity, troubleshooting, process documentation, and continuous improvement of recruitment systems and workflows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Recruitment Systems Administration & Support
  
• Act as the primary support resource for Greenhouse ATS and related recruitment technologies (Linkedin Recruiter, HireEz, DataPeople etc)
  
• Maintain role-based permissions and user access across multiple business units and entities.
  
• Provide day-to-day support to recruiters, hiring managers, HR teams, and other system users.
  
• Support system testing, upgrades, releases, and implementation of new functionality.
  
• Create and maintain system documentation, user guides, and knowledge articles.
  
• Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for optimization and automation.
  
  
Integration & Data Management
  
• Support integrations between Greenhouse, Workday, LinkedIn Recruiter, background screening providers, onboarding platforms, and other recruiting technologies.
  
• Monitor integration health and investigate data discrepancies between systems.
  
• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across recruitment platforms.
  
  
Process & User Enablement
  
• Document recruitment system processes and standard operating procedures.
  
• Deliver system training and onboarding support for recruiters and hiring managers.
  
• Promote adoption of Greenhouse best practices and new system functionality.
  
• Partner with Talent Acquisition Operations, HR Operations, and HRIS teams to improve recruitment workflows and user experience.
  
  
Required Skills & Experience
  
• Experience administering or supporting Greenhouse ATS, Workday, or similar HR and recruitment systems.
  
• Strong understanding of recruitment processes and ATS workflows.
  
• Experience managing user permissions, templates, workflows, and system configurations.
  
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  
• Experience producing reports and working with recruitment data.
  
• High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  
• Excellent communication and customer service skills.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
**About SARAS AI Institute**

SARAS AI Institute is an AI-exclusive, fully online, degree-granting institution. Our programs run from foundation certificates through MS degrees, for learners in 20+ countries. We started in 2023 with 25+ learners. Today we have thousands, and our mission is to change 1 million lives with AI education by 2030.

**Location:**
Gurugram ·
**Reports to:**
Co-Founder & COO ·
**Type:**
Full-time

**The role**

This is a hiring role. It is not an HR generalist role. Your job is to get the right people into SARAS, fast. You’ll own recruitment end to end, from the brief to the joining date, and you’ll do most of it yourself.

The rest of HR at SARAS runs on automation. That leaves you free to spend your time on what matters most to us right now: closing great hires.

You’ll be measured on hires closed, quality of hire and speed. Activity doesn’t count.

**What you’ll do**

*Close hires*

* Run the full cycle for roles across academics and faculty, technology, sales, marketing and student success: briefing, sourcing, screening, assessment, closing and offer negotiation.
* Close senior and niche roles, including PhD and industry-practitioner faculty.
* Agree hiring timelines with every business leader and hold both sides to them.

*Build the pipeline*

* Source directly through LinkedIn, referrals, communities and campus channels before turning to agencies.
* Build talent networks in India, and in the US and international markets as we grow.
* Keep a warm bench of candidates for roles we know are coming.

*Run it on data*

* Own the ATS and keep the pipeline visible on one dashboard.
* Track time-to-hire, offer-acceptance rate, source mix and cost per hire.
* Use AI tools to source, screen and schedule faster.
* Manage the few agencies we use on speed, cost and quality.

*Candidate experience*

* Give every candidate, hired or not, a fast, clear and respectful process.
* Sell SARAS well: the mission, the stage and the opportunity.

**What success looks like**

* **60 days:**
  Open critical roles closed or in the final stage. Timelines agreed with every leader. Pipeline on one dashboard.
* **4 months:**
  Hiring is predictable. Time-to-hire is down, offer acceptance is up, and agency use is down.
* **6 months:**
  Leaders see you as the reason they can scale. A warm bench is ready for upcoming roles.

**Who we’re looking for**

* 6–9 years in recruitment or talent acquisition, mostly hands-on and full-cycle.
* A track record of closing senior or niche hires at pace. Be ready to walk us through specific closures.
* Experience in edtech, higher education, tech or a high-growth startup.
* You know your numbers: time-to-hire, acceptance rates, source mix.
* Exposure to US or international hiring is a strong plus.

**How you work**

* You own outcomes and don’t wait to be told.
* You push back on vague briefs and unrealistic asks, and you bring data to back it up.
* You’re a closer. You can sell a role and handle a tough negotiation.
* You move fast, stay hands-on and are comfortable with ambiguity.

**Compensation**

Total compensation, including a performance-linked variable tied to hires closed and time-to-hire, is capped at ₹20 LPA. This is a high-ownership role with a direct line to the leadership team and room to grow into a Head of TA role as the team scales.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, creator-driven environment and enjoys building strong talent pipelines, creating a great candidate experience, and partnering closely with hiring managers to bring the right people on board.

Roles & Responsibilities

**Talent Sourcing:**

* Drive candidate sourcing through LinkedIn, job portals, social media platforms, employee referrals, and other innovative channels to build a strong talent pipeline.

**Screening & Coordination:**

* Conduct initial HR screenings, evaluate candidate fit, and coordinate interview processes seamlessly with hiring managers and candidates.

**Candidate Experience:**

* Ensure a positive and professional candidate journey through proactive communication, timely follow-ups, and smooth interview scheduling.

**Recruitment Operations:**

* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, interview feedback records, and hiring reports with high accuracy and organization.

Qualifications

* 1 year of experience in talent acquisition or recruitment, preferably within influencer marketing, media, digital agencies, startups or other high-growth environments
* Strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment processes
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn hiring, job portals, and social media sourcing
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management abilities
* Proficiency in Google Workspace / MS Office and experience with an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) is an added advantage

title: Talent Sourcer
description:
**About this Role:**
The Talent Sourcer focuses on proactively identifying and developing a pipeline of candidates aligned to specific business units utilizing multiple strategies including online databases, social media sites, Boolean keyword searching, cold calling contact lists and networking to identify top talent for our organization. If you love the thrill of the hunt and engaging with passive and hard to find candidates, this role is for you.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Source potential and passive candidates through direct channels, social media, internet sourcing, and relationship building
* Continually expand network through leveraging user groups, blogs and networking events
* Generate candidate interest through creative marketing and social media messaging by clearly articulating the Gartner value proposition
* Prequalify potential candidates to determine their qualifications through profiling, trait assessments and behavioral based interviewing (BBI)
* Develop a pipeline of talent for current role and future hiring needs
* Create Market intel for recurring/niche skills to target right talent

**What you’ll need:**

* Bachelor’s degree must, MBA preferred
* 1-3 years Recruiting or Talent Acquisition experience required
* Strong executive presence
* Strong research and candidate generation skills
* Business Development and/or Sales experience a plus
* Familiarity with current direct sourcing techniques and hands on experience on LinkedIn & Naukri
* Effective and professional communicator
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Builder of networks
* Social media savvy

**What you'll get:**

* A seat at the table to help drive peak performance in a growing, people business
* Encouragement to be innovative and challenge the status quo
* Exposure to industry leading training and development
* Performance based recognition and rewards

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Develop and monitor overall HR strategies, systems, tactics and procedures across the organization
* Regular interaction with the management for understanding the requirement and business needs.
* Handle overall recruitment and selection process through internal or external sources as per hiring guidelines
* Conducting interviews for technical and non-technical positions.
* Sourcing right candidates as per department requirements using different sources such as Head -Hunting, LinkedIn, Company mapping, referencing, Searching Job portals, etc.
* Align with business to implement talent engagement and development initiatives.
* To complete HR formalities like Letter of Intent (L.O.I), Appointment letter, Confirmation letter, Promotion letter, Increment letter, relieving letter, Exit Interviews.
* On-boarding of new employees, their Joining formalities including maintaining of the Personnel file, bank account opening and statutory requirements.
* Responsible for taking induction programs for new joiners and making them well versed with the organization's policy and procedures.
* Documenting HR processes via H.R.M.S software.
* Attendance, Payroll & Salary Administration.
* Monitor grievances and implement disciplinary policies and procedures.
* Implement innovative solutions for engaging and motivating the employees.
* Bridge management and employee relations by addressing demands, grievances, other issues by analyzing data collected through Employee Satisfaction Surveys
* Nurture a positive working environment.
* Support current and future business needs through the development, engagement, motivation and preservation of human capital.
* Oversee and manage a performance appraisal system that drives high performance.
* Maintaining the M.I.S for change of employment status, employment criteria, new joiners, confirmations, transfers, promotions, resignations.
* Handling Employee Database (Both in Soft Form and Files Management).
* Completing the Exit-Interviews formalities and Full and Final settlements.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Previous working experience of a minimum of 3 years as a HR Manager.
* Must be adept at problem-solving, including being able to identify issues and resolve programs in a timely manner.
* Must be able to communicate clearly, both written and orally, as to communicate with employees.
* Candidate should have an experience of handling a team.
* Strong understanding of MS Office and should be able to Prepare presentations and Reports regarding HR Activities.
* Must possess strong interpersonal skills.
* Candidate should have good presentation skills.
* Good experience in hiring candidates through various channels.
* Must be able to prioritize and plan work activities as to use time efficiently.
* Must be organized, accurate, thorough, and able to monitor work for quality.
* Must be dependable, able to follow instructions, respond to management direction, and must be able to improve performance through management feedback.
* Should have knowledge on Labour laws, Payroll, T.D.S, PF, E.S.I & PT.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**About the Company**

Book My Tour Now is a growing Tours & Travel company focused on creating smooth and memorable travel experiences for its customers. With a strong focus on service, teamwork, and continuous improvement, the company is building a professional and growth-oriented workplace. We believe that a strong team is the foundation of business growth.

Book My Tour Now provides a professional, supportive, and growth-focused work environment. The HR Executive will work closely with employees, managers, and management across different functions. The role provides opportunities to learn multiple areas of HR and contribute directly to building a strong workplace culture.

**About the Role**

The HR Executive will manage day-to-day HR activities including recruitment, employee onboarding, attendance, leave, payroll coordination, employee records, training, employee engagement, grievance handling, and exit formalities. The role will ensure that HR processes are completed accurately and on time while providing proper support to employees and managers. The HR Executive will also maintain updated HR records and support the company in building a disciplined, positive, and productive work environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage recruitment activities by understanding manpower requirements and coordinating with departments for hiring.
* Prepare and update Job Descriptions and publish approved openings on job portals and recruitment channels.
* Source and screen candidates through job portals, databases, agencies, and other suitable sources.
* Coordinate interviews with candidates, interview panels, and reporting managers.
* Collect interview feedback and communicate the next steps to selected candidates.
* Manage offer and joining formalities, including offer letters, joining dates, documents, and employee records.
* Coordinate employee onboarding and induction, including system access, workstation, policies, team introduction, and training.
* Monitor daily attendance and leave and ensure attendance records, missing punches, shifts, and leave approvals are updated.
* Coordinate payroll activities by providing accurate attendance, leave, deduction, and employee information to the Finance/Payroll team.
* Maintain employee documentation and HR records, including employee files, HR letters, registers, digital records, and compliance documents.
* Support employee performance, training, engagement, grievance, and discipline activities as required.
* Manage employee exit formalities, including resignation, exit interviews, clearance, full & final coordination, access removal, and record closure.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in HR, Business Administration, Management, or any relevant field.
* HR certification or relevant qualification will be an advantage.
* Freshers may apply if they have the right attitude and willingness to learn.
* Candidates with 1–3 years of HR experience will be preferred.
* Experience in recruitment, attendance, payroll coordination, or employee handling will be an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Good time management and follow-up skills.
* Ability to handle multiple HR activities at the same time.
* Good problem-solving and coordination skills.
* Basic computer and data management skills.
* Good attention to accuracy and confidentiality.
* Positive attitude and professional behaviour.
* Ability to communicate comfortably with employees, candidates, managers, and external agencies.

**Preferred Skills**

* MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* MS Word.
* Email and communication tools.
* HRMS / Attendance Management System.
* Job portals and recruitment databases.
* Google Drive / Shared folders.
* Basic knowledge of payroll and HR tracking systems.

description:

We are looking for a proactive and enthusiastic
**Talent Acquisition Intern**
to support our recruitment team in sourcing, screening, and coordinating with candidates throughout the hiring process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Coordinate interview schedules and follow up with candidates.
* Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Assist in job postings and candidate communication.
* Support the Talent Acquisition team in day-to-day recruitment activities.

**Required Skills**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of recruitment and hiring processes.
* Knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

title: Staff Recruiter
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We’re hiring a senior full-cycle recruiter to run searches across Revenue, GTM (Pre/Post Sales - Solutions Architect roles with secondary coverage for G&A as bandwidth allows (e.g., Marketing, Legal, People Ops, IT, Procurement, Executive Support). You’ll partner with senior leaders to shape hiring plans, run efficient recruiting processes, and deliver strong, vetted pipelines on tight timelines.
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role, you will own full-cycle hiring for GTM and G&A roles, including intake, calibration, sourcing, candidate assessment, offer strategy, and close. You will also flex to G&A requisitions as bandwidth permits, building pipelines and running structured processes for Finance, Legal, People Ops, IT, Procurement, and Executive Support. You’ll advise hiring managers on scoping, leveling, compensation bands, interview design, and decision quality, while running structured, fair processes that improve pass-through quality. Success in this role requires operating by the numbers, championing candidate experience, collaborating cross-functionally with People Ops/HRBPs, Finance, and Legal, and continuously improving recruiting tools, process quality, and market intelligence.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting, including GTM (Marketing/Revenue) and G&A roles in high-growth tech or adjacent industries.
* Demonstrated success recruiting G&A roles (Finance, Legal, People/HR).
* Success hiring across Manager/Director levels and hard-to-fill specialties.
* Expert intake/calibration skills; you translate fuzzy needs into crisp profiles and assessment plans.
* Strong offer strategy/closing chops with data-informed guidance on compensation, leveling, and risk tradeoffs.
* Data fluency: manage a funnel, forecast timelines, and drive decisions with metrics.
* Systems: ATS (e.g., Greenhouse), LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, Tableau.
* Context switching: ability to move seamlessly between GTM and G&A portfolios while maintaining quality and speed.

**Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.**

* You love to run efficient recruiting processes and deliver strong, vetted pipelines on tight timelines.
* You’re curious about hiring plans, market intel, and how to improve pass-through quality across GTM and G&A searches.
* You’re an expert in full-cycle recruiting, stakeholder partnership, and structured candidate assessment.

**Why CoreWeave?**
**About**
At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:
  
  

* Be Curious at Your Core
* Act Like an Owner
* Empower Employees
* Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
* Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!
  
  
The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

title: Hiring: Assistant Manager – Production (Pharmaceutical Injectables | Sterile/Non-Sterile) | Delhi NCR | Up to ₹14 LPA
description:
**Company Description**
Stavros Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a new-age pharmaceutical organization with a strong vision to become a global leader in healthcare. Built on the foundations of quality and innovation, the company focuses on scientific excellence and continuous advancement in medicine. A dedicated team of professionals works to develop and deliver breakthrough healthcare solutions that address the evolving needs of patients and medical stakeholders. Every product is designed to meet stringent quality standards and align with the latest developments in science and technology. This commitment to research, development, and improving lives positions Stavros as a trailblazer in the pharmaceutical industry.
  
**Role Description**
The Assistant Manager – Production (Pharmaceutical Injectables | Sterile/Non-Sterile) is responsible for overseeing daily production activities for injectable formulations in sterile and non-sterile environments. This full-time, on-site position is based in Bahadurgarh and involves supervising production teams, ensuring adherence to GMP and regulatory standards, and maintaining product quality and safety throughout the manufacturing process. The role includes planning and executing production schedules, coordinating with quality assurance, maintenance, and supply chain teams, and driving continuous improvement initiatives on the shop floor. The Assistant Manager will monitor equipment performance, support validation and documentation activities, troubleshoot process issues, and participate in audits and inspections. The position also involves mentoring team members, supporting training efforts, and fostering a culture of operational excellence and compliance.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Hiring and Recruiting skills to build and support a high-performing production team.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to coordinate effectively with cross-functional departments and frontline staff.
* Candidates should possess Service Quality skills to maintain consistent production standards and compliance with regulatory and customer requirements.
* Candidates should possess Training skills to onboard, guide, and upskill team members on processes, safety, and GMP practices.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Relevant experience in pharmaceutical injectables production, with exposure to sterile and non-sterile operations and GMP environments.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, documentation, regulatory guidelines, and quality systems in pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, solve operational problems, and implement process improvements safely and efficiently.

title: Talent Acquisition & People Ops Specialist
description:
📍
**Gurugram (On-site) | 🕒 Full-time**

Babaclick builds software, AI workflows and operational systems that power global commerce, connecting suppliers, marketplaces and customers across borders. We’re looking for a
**Talent Acquisition & People Ops Specialist**
to recruit the people behind these systems and support our growing teams through organised, reliable people operations.

**Technical recruitment will be your primary focus**
, particularly software engineering and AI-related roles. You’ll work closely with leadership and hiring managers to understand requirements, proactively find candidates and manage recruitment from first contact through to joining. Alongside hiring, you’ll support onboarding, employee documentation and core HR processes.

**What You’ll Do**

**Technical Recruitment**

* Manage recruitment across technical and selected business roles, from sourcing and screening through to offers and joining.
* Proactively approach candidates through LinkedIn, job platforms, referrals, technical communities and targeted research.
* Make outbound calls and conduct screening interviews to assess experience, project contributions, motivations and role suitability.
* Work with hiring managers to define selection criteria and present relevant shortlists with clear assessment notes.
* Coordinate interviews and technical assessments, gather feedback and keep hiring decisions moving.
* Maintain an organised pipeline and consistent candidate communication through offer acceptance, notice periods and joining.

**AI & Recruitment Automation**

* Use AI and automation to improve sourcing, candidate tracking, scheduling, follow-ups and reporting.
* Build or adapt practical workflows using
  **Cursor or comparable AI coding tools**
  .
* Identify and improve processes that slow hiring or create unnecessary administration.

**People Operations**

* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, including documentation, inductions and internal handovers.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, employee records, HR correspondence and trackers.
* Support attendance and leave administration, probation reviews and performance review cycles.
* Assist with HR policies, employee communications and engagement initiatives.
* Handle routine employee queries with discretion, escalating sensitive matters appropriately.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Hands-on technical recruitment experience**
  , with evidence of personally sourcing and successfully hiring software engineers or other technical talent.
* Confidence approaching candidates directly, making calls daily and conducting thoughtful screening interviews.
* Enough technical understanding to discuss software projects, technology stacks and individual contributions, and collaborate effectively with engineering interviewers.
* **Excellent spoken and written English**
  , with clear, professional communication across teams and geographies.
* Practical experience using Cursor or comparable AI tools to create useful workflows or automations—we’d like to see something you’ve personally built or improved.
* Strong organisation, judgement and follow-through, with the ability to balance hiring priorities and ongoing HR responsibilities.
* Familiarity with core HR processes, confidence using Excel / Google Sheets and care in handling confidential information.
* **Availability to join immediately and work full-time from our Gurugram office.**

**Why Join Babaclick**

* Take ownership of hiring that directly shapes our technology and business teams.
* Work closely with leadership in a growing international business.
* Help build and improve recruitment and HR processes.
* Develop your technical recruitment expertise alongside broader people operations experience.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys finding great people, asks the right questions and follows through - from the first conversation to a successful start.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the Company

MSM Unify is a global education marketplace connecting students, recruitment partners, and institutions on one platform. With a growing international presence, we are building a technology-driven education ecosystem focused on business expansion, innovation, and creating opportunities across global markets.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to selection, offer management, and onboarding coordination.
* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract high-quality talent across business functions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, role expectations, and hiring priorities.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Conduct initial candidate assessments to evaluate skills, experience, communication, and cultural fit.
* Drive recruitment targets while ensuring quality of hire and timely closure of positions.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, hiring reports, and recruitment MIS to ensure data accuracy and visibility.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Support bulk and niche hiring requirements in a fast-paced, growing organization.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition.
* Experience in end-to-end recruitment, preferably in EdTech, Education, Sales, or high-volume hiring environments.
* Strong sourcing, screening, interviewing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, and recruitment tools.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
TALENT ACQUISITION MANAGER

**Faridabad, Delhi NCR | On-site | 5–10 years | Reports to Head of HR**

We're hiring a tooling engineer, a colour management specialist, a Mandarin-speaking supplier liaison, an automation manager, a UV printing engineer, a customs specialist and a supply chain head. Different industries, different talent pools, nothing in common.

Almost none of them are on job boards. The tooling engineer is employed and not looking. The colour specialist might be the only one in the city.

That's the job: finding people who aren't advertising that they're findable.

**What you'd build**

* Sourcing pipelines per domain — where each kind of specialist actually sits, and how we reach them
* A referral network through our own engineers, our vendors and our suppliers, who know the good people long before any recruiter does
* An assessment process with the hiring managers, so technical screening is real rather than keyword matching
* An employer brand that makes a specialist in Pune consider Faridabad
* A talent map we can hire from in six months, not start from scratch each time
* Hiring capability for Germany, Australia and the UK as those open

**You'd own**

* End-to-end hiring across engineering, operations, supply chain and corporate roles
* Direct sourcing and outreach — weighted to headhunting, not screening inbound
* Candidate experience through to offer and joining
* Hiring manager partnership: pushing back on unrealistic briefs and helping sharpen them

**You need**

* 5+ years in
  **specialist or technical recruitment.**
  Volume and bulk hiring is a different skill
* **Demonstrated direct sourcing**
  — you've found and closed people who weren't applying
* **Learning velocity.**
  You'll go from tooling to customs to Mandarin liaison in a month and need to sound credible to each
* Manufacturing or engineering hiring experience strongly preferred
* The confidence to tell a hiring manager their brief won't find anyone

**Tell us:**
the hardest role you've ever filled — why it was hard, and how you found the person.

title: Vice President, Talent Acquisition
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm’s growth continues to outpace market growth and today operates from ten offices across the United States one office in the middle east and one office in Gurugram.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Delivery Enablement (DE) team supports internal stakeholders by providing a robust operational backbone across TAS, TES, OCFO, PI, IM, IB and TRS. The team includes Talent Acquisition (TA), Human Capital Management (HCM), Commercial Strategy, Marketing, Data Analytics, Accounting & Finance and Delivery Excellence. As Portage Point continues to grow, the DE team is laser focused on scalability, quality and automation.
  
  
The Vice President (VP), TA opportunity represents a unique opportunity for a highly capable recruiting professional with a proven track record of sourcing and placing top tier candidates. This is Portage Point’s first dedicated Talent Acquisition hire based in India and will be responsible for building and owning the TPI recruiting function from the ground up, in close partnership with the global TA team and local HCM leader. The Vice President, TA will work alongside the Practice Line Leaders to drive high volume and strategic recruiting outcomes across TPI. This VP will focus on flawless execution of the recruitment strategy, sourcing premier talent across various levels and delivering a best-in-class candidate and stakeholder experience, including full ownership of the end-to-end recruiting lifecycle – sourcing through offer execution.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers to identify and secure top talent across various career levels
* Own end-to-end recruiting execution within an application tracking system, including requisition management, candidate communication, interview scheduling and pipeline reporting
* Run effective TA processes that decrease interview to hire ratios and increase offer extension to acceptance ratios
* Develop and deploy effective sourcing strategies
* Accurately convey the Portage Point employee value proposition and unique advantages of each role and practice line
* Deliver an efficient and highly communicative experience to candidates and stakeholders
* Manage external agency relationships and reduce overall agency spend
* Develop and execute strategic recruiting initiatives and events
* Maintain standard operating procedures, talent dashboards / reports and recruiting exhibits
* Effectively leverage TA technology and support the research and implementation of new solutions
* Accurately report activities, outcomes and flag potential opportunities and threats
* Manage process changes by developing adequate levels of awareness, desire, knowledge, ability and reinforcement
* Facilitate effective employment branding
* Champion referral bonus program and education internally around open hiring needs
* Share and manage TA best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Contribute to creating a high-performing and inclusive culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gururgram, India
* Invested in a team-based culture and motivated to collaborate in office three days per week
* Six plus years of lateral recruiting experience, primarily in sourcing out of investment banking, private equity or other financial / professional services firms
* Expert in candidate sourcing and selection
* Skillful in screening and / or behavioral interviews
* Experience with employment branding, diversity recruitment and change management
* Full-cycle, end-to-end recruiting experience within an applicant tracking system (ATS), including ownership of interview scheduling
* Direct experience with ATS management is strongly preferred, such as Lever, Greenhouse or Ashby
* Ability to successfully work independently as well as in a small, collaborative team environment
* Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy as Portage Point’s first India-based TA hire, exercising strong judgment and independent decision-making
* High degree of maturity with a proven ability to interact with senior executives
* Effectively communicates analysis through Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint including high-quality messaging, structure and formatting
* Eagerness to be responsive at all times, including flexibility to overlap with U.S. team working hours given the cross-time-zone collaboration this role requires
* Proven track-record of success in high pressure, time-constrained environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including strong e-mail etiquette
* Top-tier organizational skills and attention to detail
* Self-starter and entrepreneurial spirit, with the ability to build a function from the ground up
