title: Enterprise Recruitment Representative - Arden University
description:
ApplyBoard simplifies the study abroad application process by connecting international students, international student advisors, and educational institutions on one personalized platform. For more than a decade, ApplyBoard's team members have been dedicated to breaking down barriers to international education, while thriving at a company that invests in their career growth. Our six core values guide us in our mission to educate the world, and are the foundation of our company culture. As an organization built on diversity, our team members are representative of the students we support.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
We are seeking a driven, well-connected, and organized professional to represent Arden University in Germany across the South Asia market. The successful candidate will lead targeted enrollment growth, enhance partner satisfaction, and serve as a liaison between Arden University, ApplyBoard, and external recruitment partners (agents). This is a hands-on, field-focused role with travel and stakeholder coordination.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing Every Day:**

* Expand international recruitment channels and plan marketing and recruitment strategies for college/university recruitment in assigned regions
* Participate in education fairs; deliver presentations to agents and prospective students; respond to inquiries from prospective students and recruitment partners.
* Conduct a high volume of partner engagement (minimum 5–8 recruitment partner visits daily) and train partners and their counselors on processes, top schools/programs, and admission requirements;
* Plan and deliver regional webinars and seminars with recruitment partners and the internal sales team.
* Ensure recruitment partner quality through regular agent training and by increasing the volume of international applicants to meet semester targets.
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with key internal stakeholders at Arden University and within ApplyBoard.
* Lead regular meetings with the University Recruitment team to monitor targets, market developments, and alignment with strategic objectives.
* Stay current with region-specific industry trends and competitor activity; provide market intelligence to ApplyBoard and Arden University leadership.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* 1-2 years of experience in account management, sales, or recruitment, preferably in the education sector.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field preferred.
* Strong understanding of enrollment processes and strategies within differentiated institutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proficient in CRM software and data analysis tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Extensive travel (15 working days per month).

**About ApplyBoard**
ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access international education. Our global team leverages cutting-edge technology to build innovative tools and share sector insights that support our network of international students and 1,500+ partner institutions. We've helped more than 1,300,000 students from over 180 countries with their study abroad journey so far, and we're just getting started.
  
  
Ready to join us? We're grateful for your interest in joining the ApplyBoard team. However, only select applicants will be contacted for an interview.

Rostrum Education supports students and families in their journey to gain admission to the world’s most competitive universities. With personalised mentorship, expert guidance, and a proven track record, we help students craft strong, standout applications.

In the 2025 admissions cycle, our students secured 10+ Oxbridge offers and 15+ Ivy League offers, showcasing the strength of our strategies and the quality of our mentorship. From Oxford to Harvard, Cambridge to Columbia, we help ambitious students turn their aspirations into achievement.

We are looking for a driven and hands-on Senior HR Associate who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role requires someone who takes complete ownership of HR processes, is proactive in problem-solving, and is comfortable operating in a dynamic, evolving setup. This position handles employee recruitment, onboarding, benefits administration, performance management, and employee relations. You will be responsible for developing and updating HR policies, ensuring legal compliance, and supporting organizational culture and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Management in HR:**
  Partner with leadership to translate business goals into people strategies covering workforce planning, headcount and budgeting, talent retention, and culture-building; use HR data and analytics to advise on organizational structure and decisions, and proactively identify people-risks and opportunities to shape long-term HR strategy
* **Policy & Compliance:**
  Draft, review, and implement HR policies in alignment with organizational needs and legal requirements, ensuring 100% communication and documentation of updates; maintain a centralized policy repository and conduct periodic reviews to ensure relevance, clarity, and compliance
* **Performance Management:**
  Implement and drive KRA/KPI frameworks across teams, ensure timely completion of performance review cycles, coordinate with stakeholders for evaluations, and maintain accurate performance records to support data-driven decision-making
* Employee Engagement & Relations: Strengthen employee experience by conducting regular check-ins, feedback surveys, and engagement initiatives; analyze feedback data to identify trends and gaps, present actionable insights to management, and drive initiatives that enhance workplace culture, collaboration, and employee satisfaction
* **Payroll, Attendance & Benefits:**
  Manage and validate monthly attendance, resolve discrepancies prior to payroll processing, and execute accurate payroll through HRMS tools (e.g., Keka); ensure timely salary disbursement, maintain payroll records, and administer employee benefits including insurance, leave, and wellness programs while addressing employee queries
* **Learning & Development:**
  Identify training and development needs through performance insights and feedback, design and implement structured learning initiatives, and facilitate training sessions and workshops to drive continuous learning, skill enhancement, and employee growth
* **HR Operations:**
  Oversee the complete employee lifecycle including reference checks, onboarding documentation, employee records management (HRMS and physical), internal transfers, and exits, while ensuring process efficiency, accuracy, and continuous improvement; act as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievances, ensuring timely and effective resolution
* **End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management:**
  Own and manage the complete employee journey, from offer acceptance and pre-boarding through onboarding, confirmation, career progression, internal mobility, and exit, as a single point of accountability; coordinate across recruitment, operations, payroll, and L&D at each milestone, and use lifecycle data to continuously improve the employee experience and flag retention risks early
* **Recruitment & Onboarding:**
  Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle including Job Description creation, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessments, and offer rollout, while maintaining a structured hiring pipeline and ensuring a seamless, positive candidate experience; design and execute a well-structured onboarding program that enables smooth integration of new hires into the organization’s culture, values, and workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Mandatory 4-5 years of hands-on HR experience across HR operations, Talent Acquisition and People Management
* Strong understanding of HR processes, systems, and best practices
* Familiarity with employment laws and compliance requirements
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-ownership, and dynamic environment

**Why Join Us?**

* Join a globally recognized and fast-growing organization in the education sector.
* Work in a dynamic, cross-functional team environment.
* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Exposure to international clients and projects with impact.
* Opportunities for professional development and advancement.

At Rostrum Education, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of race, religion, gender, nationality, disability, or sexual orientation.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**HR Manager**

**﻿**

**Talent Acquisition & People Operations Delhi NCR | Full-time | 5-8 years preferred | Reports to Founder / Leadership**

**Build the team. Build the systems.**

Dr. Morepen Home delivers doctor visits, nursing care, vaccinations, IV therapy, diagnostics and ongoing care at home. We also operate institutional health centres. We are looking for an HR Manager who has worked in a fast-paced startup and can independently own hiring and people operations as we grow.

You should have personally hired both tech and non-tech talent, managed an HRMS, implemented policies and used AI to improve day-to-day execution. This is a hands-on individual ownership role, with scope to build the function over time.

**Recruitment and workforce planning**

• Partner with founders and managers to define role requirements, hiring priorities, compensation ranges and interview plans.

• Own sourcing, screening, interviews, references, offers and joining across technology, product, sales, growth, operations, support and clinical teams.

• For tech hiring, understand role requirements, conduct effective initial screens and coordinate technical assessments with hiring managers.

• Build direct sourcing pipelines through LinkedIn, referrals, communities, job platforms and targeted outreach; use agencies selectively.

• Manage multiple live roles, share weekly pipeline updates and proactively resolve interview delays, offer drop-offs and joining risks.

• Track time to fill, offer acceptance, actual joins, sourcing mix and 90-day retention. Balance speed with hiring quality.

**Onboarding and employee lifecycle**

• Own joining documentation, induction, probation tracking, confirmations, role changes and exits.

• Coordinate background checks and clinical credential verification with medical leadership before deployment.

• Give new hires clear responsibilities, reporting lines, goals and check-ins; support managers through the first 90 days.

**Own HR operations**

Practical systems, clear policies and accountable execution.

**HRMS, payroll coordination and policies**

• Independently administer the HRMS: employee records, attendance, leave rules, approval flows, onboarding, exits, reporting and access permissions.

• Coordinate accurate monthly payroll inputs with finance, including attendance exceptions, new joiners, exits and approved incentives.

• Draft, implement and explain policies covering leave, attendance, conduct, reimbursements, confidentiality and performance.

• Coordinate applicable employment and statutory requirements with finance, legal advisers and external specialists; maintain organised documentation.

**Performance, employee relations and retention**

• Set up probation reviews, role-specific goals, feedback cycles and documented performance improvement plans.

• Resolve employee concerns fairly, support managers with difficult conversations and follow through on agreed actions.

• Analyse early exits, recurring absenteeism and retention concerns; recommend practical improvements.

**Use AI and automation in daily work**

• Use AI for sourcing research, search strings, role briefs, interview guides, policy drafts and reporting, with human review.

• Build useful automations for interview coordination, onboarding reminders, probation alerts and recurring HR reports.

• Show measurable improvements in turnaround time or administrative effort. Use approved tools and protect candidate and employee information.

**What you should bring**

• Typically 5-8 years in recruitment and HR, including at least 2 years in a fast-paced startup or comparable scaling business.

• Evidence of personally closing both tech and non-tech hires, managing simultaneous vacancies and working directly with founders or business heads.

• Hands-on HRMS administration and policy implementation experience, beyond data entry or forwarding issues to a vendor.

• Practical AI skills, strong Excel or Google Sheets ability, clear English and Hindi communication, discretion and dependable follow-through.

title: Recruitment Analyst
description:
**Recruitment Analyst**

**Location:**
Noida, India

**Experience:**
1-3 years

**About the Company**

TheHireHub.AI is an AI-driven recruitment platform that helps organizations modernize and streamline the hiring process. Its technology automates key stages of recruitment, including sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and coordination, enabling hiring teams to work faster and make better-informed decisions. Built on insights from more than 3,000 global hiring projects, the platform supports mid-market and growth-stage companies across India, APAC, and MEA, with an expanding global presence. TheHireHub.AI was founded by executive search veterans with more than 20 years of global hiring expertise, combining practical recruitment knowledge with technology-led innovation. The company is focused on empowering recruiters by reducing administrative work and giving them more time for strategic decision-making. As a growing technology organization, TheHireHub.AI values innovation, efficiency, empowerment, and an inclusive workplace. Its mission is to transform recruitment through AI-driven solutions that make hiring more effective, seamless, and efficient for modern teams.

**About the Role**

The Recruitment Analyst will own day-to-day recruitment support across candidate sourcing, pipeline tracking, interview coordination, reporting, and recruitment data accuracy. Through applicant tracking systems, spreadsheets, communication tools, and structured workflows, this role will improve recruiter productivity and stakeholder visibility. The analyst will convert recruitment activity into reliable insights, identify process gaps, and ensure candidates receive timely updates throughout the hiring journey. Success means cleaner pipelines, faster coordination, accurate reporting, stronger candidate experience, and consistent progress against open hiring requirements. The role requires close collaboration with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates while balancing administrative precision with practical problem-solving. It is well suited to an early-career recruitment professional who wants to build strong foundations in recruitment operations and analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate candidate records, requisition data, interview stages, and disposition outcomes in the applicant tracking system, improving pipeline visibility and reporting reliability.
* Support sourcing and screening workflows by organizing candidate information, tracking outreach, and highlighting qualified profiles against agreed role requirements.
* Coordinate interviews across candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers, reducing scheduling delays and ensuring every participant has timely, clear information.
* Prepare recurring recruitment reports covering funnel movement, source performance, ageing, conversion rates, and hiring progress to support evidence-based decisions.
* Monitor recruitment workflows for incomplete data, stalled candidates, and process bottlenecks, escalating issues early so hiring timelines remain on track.
* Maintain professional candidate communication throughout the process, strengthening responsiveness, engagement, and the overall candidate experience.
* Partner with recruiters and stakeholders to improve templates, trackers, dashboards, and operating procedures that increase consistency and execution quality.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* 1–3 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, recruitment coordination, or recruitment operations, with practical understanding of hiring workflows and candidate management.
* Strong working knowledge of applicant tracking systems, recruitment databases, spreadsheets, and reporting tools, with the ability to maintain accurate, structured data.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong follow-through, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple recruitment priorities in an onsite team environment.
* Ability to interpret basic recruitment metrics, identify funnel issues, and present concise updates that help recruiters and hiring managers act quickly.
* Comfortable coordinating with candidates and internal stakeholders while protecting confidentiality, maintaining professionalism, and meeting agreed service levels.

**Additional Plus**

* Exposure to sourcing platforms, recruitment marketing channels, Boolean search, or candidate outreach tools would help improve pipeline-building effectiveness.
* Experience creating recruitment dashboards, automated trackers, or process documentation would support stronger operational visibility and consistency.
* Familiarity with recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, source conversion, ageing, offer-to-join ratio, and recruiter productivity would be advantageous.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring 1–3 years of practical recruitment experience and understand how candidates move from sourcing through screening, interviews, selection, and joining. Your foundation enables you to contribute immediately while continuing to grow.
* You are organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning recruitment data. You can keep systems current, reconcile information across trackers, and ensure reports reflect the actual state of every hiring pipeline.
* You communicate clearly with candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers. You follow up consistently, set expectations early, and handle sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
* You use data to improve execution rather than report activity alone. You can spot delays, missing information, weak conversion points, and recurring coordination issues, then recommend practical improvements.
* You are comfortable working onsite in Noida and collaborating closely with a team. You bring a dependable, proactive mindset and take responsibility for closing loops across multiple open requirements.
* You are motivated by recruitment outcomes: qualified candidates progressing on time, stakeholders having better visibility, and candidates receiving a respectful, well-managed experience.
* You are willing to learn new recruitment technologies, processes, and analytics methods, applying feedback quickly to improve quality, speed, and consistency.

**Why Join Us**

* Own work that directly improves recruitment execution, pipeline visibility, candidate experience, and stakeholder confidence across active hiring requirements.
* Build broad, practical expertise across sourcing support, applicant tracking, interview coordination, reporting, recruitment analytics, and process improvement.
* Work closely with recruiters and hiring stakeholders in an onsite environment where disciplined execution, learning, and dependable collaboration are valued.
* Develop a strong foundation for long-term growth in talent acquisition, recruitment operations, and people analytics through measurable responsibilities and hands-on exposure.

**What We Offer**

* An onsite role in Noida with direct exposure to recruitment operations, candidate pipelines, hiring stakeholders, and practical recruitment analytics.
* The opportunity to work on meaningful hiring workflows while developing stronger skills in coordination, reporting, sourcing support, and process improvement.
* A structured environment where accuracy, ownership, communication, and measurable recruitment outcomes are recognized.

title: Account Management Associate
description:
**The short version:**

**Who we’re looking for:**
Someone who’s great at building relationships, managing multiple priorities, and making sure things get done. You’re organised, proactive, and comfortable coordinating with different people to keep things moving. You take ownership, stay on top of deadlines, and can think on your feet when things don’t go as planned.

**What this role is about:**
You’ll work with our recruiter partners - the companies that hire from Kraftshala - to make their hiring experience seamless. From setting up placement drives and coordinating with internal teams to solving last-minute challenges, you’ll be the bridge that keeps everything connected and running smoothly.

**Why you should apply:**
This is a role where you’ll see your work translate into real outcomes - recruiters finding the right talent and students landing their first jobs. You’ll sharpen your communication, problem-solving, and relationship-management skills - the kind that’ll set you up for any leadership or business role in the future. And the cherry on top? You’ll get to build a network that most people only dream of - working directly with the top leadership of some of India’s best brands and marketing agencies.

**About us:**
Kraftshala is India's largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate overall and a 100% placement rate in our sales programs, and we are gunning to become the world's largest career launchpad, across domains.

We're backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The detailed version:**

One of the biggest reasons students choose Kraftshala is our strong placement outcomes, and one of the biggest reasons companies continue to hire from Kraftshala is our track record of seamless execution, strong candidate quality, and consistent recruiter experience - and that’s exactly why the Recruiter Partnerships (Account Management) team is such a critical part of the organization.

**Primary Responsibilities will include:**

***Placement Operations***

* Managing end-to-end placement drives for assigned recruiter accounts, ensuring timelines and quality standards are consistently met
* Planning and executing placement logistics - interview schedules, assessments, candidate lists - in close coordination with hiring teams and internal stakeholders
* Serving as the primary point of contact for recruiters during the placement cycle, ensuring proactive communication and prompt resolution of queries
* Collaborating with student-facing and operations teams to ensure students are well-prepared and responsive throughout the process
* Tracking and analyzing performance data (e.g. interview conversion rates, recruiter feedback) to identify trends and improvement areas
* Identifying opportunities to grow and retain recruiter relationships through consistent delivery and trust-building

***Process Optimization***

Every delayed email, broken link, or missed follow-up can erode trust - and in placements, trust is everything. That’s why we’re constantly refining the way we operate, and hence, you’d be:

* Utilizing an array of tools, softwares, and platforms to automate processes in order to minimize human intervention and ensuring a flawless and effortless delivery of our placement cycles.
* Facilitating seamless collaboration with the product team to introduce innovative platform features and enhance operational efficiency.

**Monthly Outcomes:**

* **Month 1:**
  Understand all current placement processes, tools, and workflows. Assist in 2-3 drives and begin managing recruiter and student interactions.
* **Month 2:**
  Run 3-4 recruiter accounts independently with 90%+ student participation and <24hr query response time. Identify 3-5 process gaps.
* **Month 3+:**
  Implement at least 2 process improvements. Maintain Recruiter and Student NPS. Drive at least one automation initiative.

***A question we’d like to address upfront is what the career trajectory looks like for someone in this role.***

At Kraftshala, operations are central to how we serve our stakeholders. You'll start by learning the craft of partnerships and account management through hands-on placement execution. Over time, two broad paths could open up:

* If your strengths lie in scaling processes, systems thinking, and managing cross-functional execution, you could lead placement operations - shaping how we deliver outcomes to recruiters and students at scale.
* If you love building and growing relationships, you could transition into owning large recruiter portfolios and driving new partnerships, repeat engagement, and even leading B2B initiatives.

These are starting thoughts, of course, and any decision on a role is always a function of what a person wants matched with what the organization can offer at that time. The great advantage of a company that’s growing well (like Kraftshala) is that new opportunities open up frequently, and our preference would always be to try to fill up newly created roles with candidates from within the organization.

**Must-Haves:**

* 0-2 years of prior experience in process management, relationship building, operations, or similar customer-facing roles (We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)
* Prior experience managing career services, placements, or corporate relations in an education institution would be a big plus

**Top Grading:**

We’re looking for someone who doesn't wait around for instructions to get started. Our A-Players are those who take initiative - they build relationships with all stakeholders, spot gaps early, and design solutions proactively. They are the ones who take full ownership of the student and recruiter experience, staying a few steps ahead of any possible issues.

A B-Player, on the other hand, might wait for work to be assigned or limit themselves to what's been explicitly stated. They may execute tasks well, but aren't thinking beyond what's in front of them - which doesn't quite cut it in a high-ownership, high-trust team like ours.

**Recruitment Process:**

As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30-60 minutes, and will be a mix of online and in-person interactions.

* **Conversation 1:**
  This will be a virtual call with the HR team to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process to set expectations about what you’re signing up for
* **Technical Exercise:**
  This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
* **Conversation 2:**
  This will be a detailed assessment review conversation with the Operations team to go over your submission for the technical exercise.
* **Conversation 3:**
  This will be a conversation where you can expect to be further evaluated on the competencies needed for the job (mentioned above).
* **Conversation 4:**
  A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode (read below about it).
* **Reference Check:**
  We’ll speak with references provided by you, to learn about their experience of working with you, your strengths, and where you shine
* **Extending an offer:**
  If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.

**Location:**

Gurugram

Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Great Teams Don’t Happen by Accident**

Behind every ambitious company is someone who can recognise exceptional talent before everyone else does—and influence that talent to make the right career move.

At Inc42,
**Talent Acquisition**
is a business-critical mandate that requires market intelligence, sound judgement, candidate influence and the ability to close high-value talent.

From identifying a specialist product leader or growth marketer to engaging an experienced editor, designer or technologist, you will help build the teams shaping how India’s startup economy is reported, understood and experienced.

If you know how to find talent hidden in plain sight, establish authority with accomplished candidates, influence senior stakeholders and successfully negotiate complex offers, we would like to hear from you.

**Why This Role Exists**

Inc42 is expanding across media, intelligence, products, events, communities and learning. That growth depends on hiring people who combine functional excellence with curiosity, ownership and an entrepreneurial mindset.

We are looking for a
**Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist**
to own full-cycle recruitment across Product, Marketing, Growth, Technology, Design, Editorial and leadership functions.

You will work closely with the Head of People Operations, Founders and Functional Leaders to translate business requirements into compelling talent mandates, build high-quality candidate pipelines and take candidates from the first conversation through assessment, negotiation, closure and onboarding.

This role requires the instincts of a talent hunter, the influence of a trusted advisor and the commercial judgement of an effective closer.

**About Inc42**

**Inc42**
is India’s largest media and intelligence platform focused on the startup economy—but we are not just one kind of company.

We operate at the intersection of journalism, data intelligence, technology, founder learning, iconic industry experiences and high-trust communities. Our ecosystem includes:

* **Inc42’s authoritative journalism**
  , reporting on the companies, people and forces shaping India’s technology economy
* **Datalabs**
  , India’s largest free startup database, covering 75,000+ companies
* **D2CX**
  , our learning and community platform designed to help D2C founders build, scale and lead stronger businesses
* Flagship editorial IPs such as the
  **AI Summit,

  D2C & Retail Summit
  ,
  FAST42
  and
  D2C Retreat**
* **Griffin**

  ,
  India’s most curated private founder club

This breadth brings together an unusually diverse team of journalists, researchers, product builders, technologists, designers, marketers, creators, educators and business operators—all working towards one mission: to inform, enable and connect the people building India’s technology economy. For Talent Acquisition, that makes Inc42 a uniquely exciting organisation to build. Hiring here is neither repetitive nor transactional. One mandate could involve finding a deeply specialised editorial leader, the next a product or technology professional, and another a creative, growth, learning or business leader.

As part of People Operations, you will help build the multidisciplinary teams behind Inc42’s next phase—shaping the organisation from the inside while influencing how India’s startup economy is understood on the outside.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Continuously collaborate with PeopleOps head and function heads to refine, implement, and execute innovative recruiting strategies
* Develop & evolve job descriptions & specifications
* Work on multiple open roles across teams and ensure that every hire is a culture fit 'A' player
* Source candidates using a variety of search methods to build a robust candidate pipeline
* Grow and foster relationships with a database of qualified active and passive talent to pull from as new positions open up
* Facilitate the offer process by extending the offer & negotiating employment terms
* Monitor & apply recruiting best practices
* Ensure all screening, hiring, and selection is done in accordance with employment laws & regulations.
* Network with potential hires through professional groups on social media
* Track hiring metrics such as time-to-source, time-to-hire, source of hire etc.

**Professional Traits**

* Ability to conduct different types of Interviews (structured, competency based, stress etc.)
* Proficiency in Applicant Tracking Systems
* Prior experience in managing niche media hiring
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, decision-making, and organizational skills
* Fair understanding of employment laws & regulations
* Deep understanding of the start-up ecosystem and media industry
* Ability to discover & attract passive talents.
* Obsessive about smashing targets out of the window
* Ability to work with limited direct supervision
* Up to date with latest trends and best practices in talent across digital media space and the startup ecosystem

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Management or a related discipline, with a strong academic track record.
* 4–8 years of proven experience in Talent Acquisition, recruitment or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated ownership of mid-to-senior and leadership hiring mandates.
* Proven success in identifying, engaging, negotiating with and closing senior-level candidates.
* Experience handling complex compensation discussions, competing offers, counteroffers and candidate objections.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including the confidence to influence senior leaders and constructively challenge hiring requirements.
* Ability to establish credibility and authority with experienced, highly selective candidates.
* Experience conducting structured, competency-based and situational interviews.
* Proficiency in Applicant Tracking Systems.
* Advanced working knowledge of MS Office, database management and internet research.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, decision-making and organisational skills.
* Working understanding of applicable employment laws and hiring regulations.
* Deep understanding of the startup ecosystem and digital media industry.
* Experience hiring across Product, Marketing, Growth, Technology, Design, Editorial or other specialist functions.
* Prior experience managing niche media hiring would be highly valued.
* Experience in digital media, startups, technology or another fast-growth environment would be advantageous.
* A stable professional track record is strongly preferred, demonstrating sustained ownership, professional progression and measurable impact within organisations.

Education and Experience

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
  
  
Talent Sourcing, Mapping and Pipeline Management

Recruitment Delivery and Candidate Management

* Build effective working relationships with Talent Acquisition, HR, Talent Management, hiring managers, candidates, and relevant support teams.
* Coordinate recruitment progress reviews, capture decisions and actions, and proactively follow up to keep hiring activity moving.

title: SENIOR MANAGER – HUMAN RESOURCES  & PEOPLE OPERATIONS
description:
**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
**About Allica Bank**
 Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company \- and the fastest\-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
   

  

 Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities \- representing over a third of our economy \- yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
   

  

**Department Description**
 The Human Resource team is a small but growing team who are supporting Allica Bank and its employees to reach their goals. We’re a hands\-on team and there is great opportunity to develop your career whilst you help build one of the UK’s newest banks. Our employees are what helps us different from our competitors as part of the Human Resources team you will work on projects including engagement, recruitment, reward, L\&D and our ways of working with the aim of ensuring our employees are as effective as possible and Allica is truly great place to work.
   

  

**Role Description**
 The role of Senior Recruiter at Allica Bank will be responsible for leading recruitment campaigns across the business. The role will play a key part in ensuring that Allica Bank has the resources it requires to meet its growth agenda and ensuring that all candidates who are interacting with Allica Bank have a best\-in\-class candidate experience. The person will work with the Recruitment team, India head and Stakeholders to implement Allica’s recruitment strategy utilising methods to attract candidates, screen applicants, headhunt, arrange interviews and support candidates through to being onboarded as colleagues.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities** 
 
   

  

* Hire great people at pace 
* Build great relationships across the bank and support with the relevant business areas to assess their recruitment needs and manage campaigns to meet these needs
* Manage Allica Bank’s recruitment channels through agencies, direct and social media
* Manage Allica Banks End to End recruitment process  I
* nterview and screen prospective candidates to provide the business with high quality and diverse candidates 
* Role model and promote Allica culture and values 
* Develop and produce recruitment MI to support the refinement of Allica’s process and to drive improved outcomes for candidates and Allica


**Personal Attributes \& Experience** 
 
   

  

* Overall experience of 8\-10 years with Previous Banking/FS recruitment experience in managing the full recruitment cycle and the delivery of recruitment services, ideally from an in\-house environment or an RPO or recruitment agency 
* Proven experience of implementing recruitment strategies across organisations
* Experience in working with 3rd party suppliers such as media and agencies and Linkedin 
* Experience using Direct sourcing tools (such as LinkedIn, talent pooling, Executive Search and working with relevant job boards) 
* Commercial understanding of the business and how recruitment can support the requirements of stakeholders
* Strong organisational skills, to manage multiple recruitment campaigns, demands and tight deadlines 
* Ability to plan ahead to provide proactive Recruitment support to the business  Pragmatic, diplomatic, and a good team player
* Strong interpersonal skills, working effectively at all levels of the organisation


**Working at Allica Bank**
 At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
   

  

 Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
   

  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity \& Paternity leave


**Don’t tick every box?**
 Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
   

  

**Flexible working**
 We know the ‘9\-to\-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
   

  

**Diversity**
 We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Manager/Sr Manger
description:
We are looking for a dynamic
 **Manager/ Senior Manager \- Corporate Relations** 
 for
 **Pearl Academy** 
 to drive our student placement initiatives, strengthen industry, alumni partnerships, and career development programs. This role is crucial in bridging academia with industry, ensuring students have the necessary opportunities, skills, and networks for successful career outcomes.
 



**1\. Placements:** 



* Initiate and manage the campus recruitment and placement process, ensuring successful job placements for graduating students in Undergraduate, Post Graduate \& Professional courses.
* Collaborate with faculty to prepare students for interviews, including resume writing, mock interviews, profiling and skill assessments.
* Maintain a database of job opportunities, internships, and co\-branded programs from industry partners.
* Analyze placement trends, monitor student employment outcomes, support MIS with correct \& timely data and generate reports for senior leadership.
* Organize and host career fairs, Pre\-placement talks, networking events, and on\-campus recruitment drives.



**2\. Alumni Relations:** 



* Prioritize alumni network to provide recruitment to maximum graduating students.
* Develop and maintain a regular alumni engagement strategy to strengthen the institution’s network of successful graduates.
* Collaborate with alumni to create mentorship programs, guest lectures, and networking opportunities for current students.
* Organize alumni reunions, conferences, and recognition events to maintain active engagement.
* Track alumni career progressions and use their success stories to inspire current students and promote the institution’s reputation.



**3\. Industry Partnerships:** 



* Getting industry to the campuses.
* Identify and cultivate new partnerships with companies, industry leaders, and professional organizations to create job, internship, graduation projects and masterclasses/mentorship opportunities for students.
* Strengthen existing relationships with corporate partners, ensuring a pipeline of opportunities for students across various courses. Keeping the record of the same on daily basis.
* Develop collaborative \& financially beneficial projects with industry partners to create hands\-on learning opportunities for students under faculty led projects.
* Stay informed about industry trends, hiring needs, and workforce developments to ensure alignment of student skillsets with market demand.
* Assist in managing advisory board meetings \& members



**4\. Career Development Initiatives:** 



* Work closely with faculty and the career services team to organize workshops, seminars, and guest lectures focused on career readiness.
* Track \& ensure alignment with School For Life (SFL) to deliver training sessions for students on professional development \& industry\-specific skills.
* Collaborate with academic departments to align curriculum with industry needs, ensuring students are well\-prepared for their careers.



**5\. Project Management:** 



* Manage tasks provided in projects.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to design and implement new initiatives that enhance revenue generation \& institute promotion.
* Develop and track timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure successful completion of projects.
* Monitor and evaluate the impact of programs, providing data\-driven insights to inform continuous improvement.



**Additional Responsibilities** 




 ✔️
 **Facilitating Employment:** 



* Convince companies to recruit students through campus placements and internships.
* Ensure strong presence on professional networking platforms to enhance employer engagement.



 ✔️
 **Soft Skills \& Technical Proficiency:** 



* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation abilities.
* Strong analytical skills for placement data interpretation and reporting.
* Expertise in MS Office (Excel, Advanced Excel, Power BI, PPT).



 ✔️
 **Operational \& Strategic Coordination:** 



* Willingness to travel and manage stretched timelines.
* Handle student counseling, resolve queries, and maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of academic curricula.
* Act as a communication bridge between internal and external stakeholders.



  





  





**Who Should Apply?** 



* Proven track record in placements, career services, business development, or industry partnerships.
* Ability to oversee multiple initiatives while maintaining project management efficiency.
* Experience in education institutions of repute, banking, or insurance sectors is a plus.
* Certification in project management is an added advantage.
* Strong adaptability to a fast\-paced environment with collaborative teamwork skills.
* Work Location \- Delhi/Mumbai/Bangalore

title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring an Assistant Manager, People and Culture for our corporate office in New Delhi.
 



  





  





  





 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.
 



  





  





  





 Selection process: telephonic screening → in\-person interview at the New Delhi corporate office → reference checks → offer.
 



  





  





  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

 Stantech AI builds enterprise\-grade products designed to be fully customised — fitting each organisation precisely while staying scalable and cost\-efficient at any size. What sets us apart is resolving what most systems treat as trade\-offs: deep customisation without sacrificing scale, and sophistication without excess cost.

 You will own hiring end to end at Stantech AI. This is a recruitment\-first role: sourcing, screening and closing the engineers, sales professionals and operators who will define the next stage of the company. You will work directly with the founder and function heads, run a tight and fast process, and build the systems — pipelines, tooling, employer brand — that let us hire well at speed.

* Own the full recruitment cycle across engineering (backend, mobile, DevOps), sales (business development, channel sales) and support functions — from role definition to offer acceptance and onboarding

* Partner with hiring managers to define role scorecards, structure interviews and calibrate on candidate quality

**Why Stantech AI** 



* Direct line to the founder and complete ownership of the hiring function

We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for an engineering manager to join our Human Capital Development (HC Dev) team based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. HC Dev builds and operates the core platforms and data systems that support how the firm hires, assesses, develops, and retains its people. We are in the midst of a broader evolution of these platforms, spanning their data foundations and use of AI, creating significant opportunities to shape their architecture, technical direction, and future.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will lead an engineering team with ownership of its technical direction and delivery. You will work closely with other engineering managers and senior engineers across HC Dev, shape the roadmap in partnership with the business, drive architecture and engineering quality, and develop the engineers on your team. You will lead the design and delivery of web applications, data platforms, and supporting infrastructure, working closely with business stakeholders and product managers. You will set the technical direction for the systems your team owns, working with senior engineers and leads to drive architecture, key design decisions, and engineering quality. The team’s technology stack includes Java/Spring, React/TypeScript, SQL Server, and Python. You will manage a team of engineers, including senior engineers and leads, with responsibility for performance, career growth, and team effectiveness. You will shape the roadmap for your area with business leadership and product managers, and own planning, estimation, capacity planning, and scope management while navigating delivery risks, trade\-offs, and escalations independently. You will remain close to design and development, guiding the team on engineering best practices and providing technical leadership on complex, high\-impact problems. You will mentor engineers on both technology and domain aspects to support their growth and development.
   

  

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field, with 8 to 11 years of relevant experience
* Robust software design and architecture experience, with sound judgment on trade\-offs involving scalability, availability, security, and maintainability
* Experience managing and developing engineers, including providing feedback, coaching, and supporting career growth
* Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders, shape requirements and technical direction, build alignment, and handle escalations independently
* Solid software engineering background across web applications, backend services, or data\-intensive systems, with experience building and operating production systems at scale
* Proven experience delivering complex projects end to end, including planning, estimation, execution, and course correction
* Robust problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on engineering quality and sound technical judgment
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience engineering production AI systems, including retrieval, agentic workflows, tool use, model orchestration, and integration with enterprise data and services
* Experience taking AI capabilities from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, reliability, and operating these systems as models and underlying dependencies evolve

 solutions for various office needs through its solutions.
 



 If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic, fast\-growing organisation that values talent and fosters
 



 growth, join us and build your future with Your Desk.
 



  





**About the Role — “Human Resouces Executive”** 




 The HR team is dedicated to building the people function of Your Desk — from hiring the right talent to supporting them through their journey with us. This role plays a central part in every centre's operations by keeping our people processes running smoothly and compliantly. We are looking for a dynamic, detail\-oriented HR Executive to own end\-to\-end HR operations for Your Desk LLP, working closely with the founder, centre managers, and community managers across all locations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Recruitment \& Onboarding** 




 • Manage the full recruitment cycle — sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and offer rollout — for roles across all Your Desk centres.
 



 • Prepare and issue offer letters and appointment letters in line with company templates and standard terms.
 



 • Coordinate onboarding and induction for new joiners, including documentation, orientation, and centre placement.
 



**HR Operations \& Compliance** 




 • Maintain accurate employee records, HR databases, and personnel files (physical and digital).
 



 • Track attendance, leaves, and probation timelines across all centres; flag confirmations and renewals on time.
 



 • Administer and help implement HR policies — leave policy, code of conduct, and other company guidelines.
 



 • Ensure statutory and labour law compliance (PF, ESI, POSH, and other applicable regulations).
 



 • Maintain HR MIS and prepare periodic reports for leadership.
 



**Employee Relations \& Engagement** 




 • Act as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievances, escalating as needed.
 



 • Support performance review cycles and coordinate feedback documentation with centre managers. • Assist with employee engagement initiatives and culture\-building activities across centres.
 



 • Manage full and final settlements, exit interviews, and offboarding formalities.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (mandatory).
 



 • MBA or Post\-Graduate Diploma in HR is an added advantage.
 



 • Minimum 2 years of hands\-on experience in an HR generalist role.
 



 • Prior experience in real estate, coworking, hospitality, or a multi\-location service business is preferred.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




 We are looking for driven professionals who combine strong process discipline with genuine care for people. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
 



 • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 



 • Working knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and comfort with HR/attendance tools.
 



 • Integrity, dependability, responsibility, accountability, self\-awareness, work ethic, and empathy.
 



 • Highly organised and detail\-oriented, with the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
 



 • Strong multitasking abilities to manage HR operations across multiple centre locations.
 



 • A problem\-solving mindset with a high sense of ownership.
 



  





**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, Permanent
 



**Work Location:** 
 In person — Gurugram, Haryana (reliably commute or plan to relocate before
 



 starting work — preferred).

title: Talent Acquisition Associate
description:
**About MyHQ**
 myHQ is India's largest commercial real estate and flex workspace marketplace. Founded in 2016 by IIT Delhi graduates, we give 50,000\+ enterprises\- from early\-stage startups to large MNCs and GCCs, access to 10,000\+ workspace options across 10\+ cities, covering coworking, virtual offices, meeting rooms, and managed offices.
   

  

 In five years, we've grown 30x and closed two back\-to\-back profitable years. Backed by ANAROCK Group and WeWork India, we're building toward ₹1,000Cr, and hiring the team that gets us there.
   

  

 We believe where you work shapes what you build. Our mission is to make the right workspace accessible to every business in India, and increasingly, beyond it. With expansion already underway in Dubai and London, we're building something with a genuinely large surface area.
   

  

 For the people who join us, that translates to real opportunity. We've paid out over ₹10Cr in performance bonuses in the last couple of years, and we've watched team members buy homes, build wealth, and grow into roles that didn't exist when they joined. The next five years will be harder than the last five, and significantly more rewarding.
   

  

**Our Culture**
**We Look For People With The Following Characteristics**
* Humble and hardworking: Two traits we hire for and live by; the best people here are the ones who show up fully and let the work speak
* High ownership: You'll own real work from day one, not just assist on it; the buck stops with you, and leadership backs you up
* Bias for action: We move fast, learn faster, and don't overthink; experimentation is encouraged, paralysis is not
* Open and direct: Smart people, honest conversations, no politics; feedback flows both ways and that's how we get better


**Our Products**
* Day Passes: On demand access to coworking spaces across India, booked by the day
* Meeting Rooms: Hourly bookings across 2,000\+ venues in 10\+ cities
* Virtual Offices: Registered business address with GST support and mail handling
* Managed Offices: Fully fitted, ready\-to\-move offices with no long\-term lock\-in
* Enterprise Leasing: End\-to\-end commercial leasing for large teams, handled by our Assisted Marketplace team
* MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibition): Venue sourcing and management for corporate events, trainings, off\-sites, and conferences


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a high\-ownership Talent Acquisition Associate who will be the engine behind myHQ's hiring sourcing, screening, and moving candidates through the pipeline across our sales, operations, and marketplace verticals.
   

  

 This role requires someone who knows how to source fast, understands high\-volume sales hiring, can move fast and build strong pipelines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Source candidates across LinkedIn, Naukri, and referrals for sales, operations, and support roles
* Manage high\-volume hiring pipelines across sales teams
* Run first\-round screening calls and assess fit before scheduling the interviews with the business team
* Own interview scheduling and coordination across busy internal calendars
* Maintain pipeline hygiene, accurate records on our ATS with right stages and information
* Track offer\-to\-joining conversion and flag risks before they become vacancies
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for inside sales and business development roles
* Support sourcing strategy inputs for campus and lateral hiring
* Proactively create talent pools for recurring roles


**Requirements**
* 1–4 years of Talent Acquisition experience, ideally at a fast\-moving startup or services company
* Strong sourcer: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, referral activation
* Clear communicator: candidates should feel informed, not chased
* Genuinely organized to handle high volume bulk hiring
* Ability to work on an ATS is a plus
* Experience in sales hiring / inside sales hiring is mandatory

* Keep a record of outreach efforts and candidate databases (intern / fresher / full\-time).

* Research new recruitment platforms and outreach ideas.

description:
We are seeking a dynamic and driven HR Professional to join our team. This role will have a strong focus on Talent Acquisition with responsibility for driving end\-to\-end recruitment across the organization, strengthening our talent pipeline, and delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
 



 This role will also contribute to the broader employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee engagement, people initiatives, HR analytics, and strategic projects aimed at improving the overall employee experience and organizational effectiveness.
 



 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on recruiter who enjoys building relationships, identifying great talent, and partnering closely with hiring managers, while also being interested in contributing to broader people and culture initiatives in a growing organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\.Talent Acquisition –** 



* Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to attract high\-quality candidates for various positions within the organization.
* Conduct initial screening interviews, assess candidates' qualifications, and coordinate interviews with hiring managers, ensuring alignment with organizational needs.
* Independently lead the campus hiring process and ensure strong relationships with top educational institutions to expand sourcing reach.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process, from initial contact to onboarding, by providing timely communication and feedback.



  





**2\.Employee Lifecycle \& People Experience \-** 



* Support a seamless transition from candidate to employee by coordinating pre\-boarding and onboarding activities and ensuring new hires are effectively integrated into the organization.
* Own and continuously improve onboarding processes, orientation programs, documentation, and employee touchpoints during the initial stages of employment.
* Support employee engagement and experience initiatives that strengthen connection, collaboration, and retention.
* Act as an accessible point of contact for employees on day\-to\-day people\-related queries and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.
* Support key employee lifecycle processes and ensure HR policies and practices are communicated clearly and implemented consistently.



  





**3\.Strategic People Initiatives \& Projects \-** 



* Contribute to strategic HR and people initiatives focused on improving employee experience, organizational effectiveness, culture, and ways of working.
* Participate in projects such as Half\-Yearly Townhalls, R\&R Programs, Annual Offsites, Mid\-Year Meets, talent initiatives, and other people priorities.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to implement or improve HR systems, tools, processes, and workflows that enhance efficiency and employee experience.
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate people processes and contribute to building scalable HR practices.
* Research emerging HR and talent trends and recommend relevant practices or initiatives for the organization.



  





**4\. People Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Maintain and track key talent acquisition and people metrics, with a particular focus on recruitment pipeline health, hiring turnaround times, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and joining ratios.
* Prepare periodic recruitment and HR dashboards and reports to provide visibility into key trends and outcomes.
* Use data and insights to identify recruitment bottlenecks, improve hiring effectiveness, and support informed people\-related decision\-making.
* Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of recruitment and employee\-related data and documentation.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**HR Manager Job Description**
